question: Can a VLM, given the owner's five conditions and the owner's own example charts, pick the owner's squeeze breakouts out of a loose rule net well enough (agreement with held-out owner labels) that its picks can then be tested against matched random entries after cost?

stages.candidates: loose rule net = squeeze_breakout_v1 always-on breakout candle (direction, body/range >= 0.55, close beyond all six MAs and the 12-bar extreme) + BB compression + volume ratio >= 1.5; dense MAs, engulfing and big body are left to the VLM; 12-bar cooldown; 1H first
stages.render: 120 closed bars ending at the signal bar; six close MAs SMA/EMA 20/60/120 (SMA solid, EMA dashed, legend), BB SMA200 +/- 2 population stdev, volume pane; no signal, label or outcome annotation; nothing after the signal bar; MAs and bands computed from bars up to the signal only; deterministic PNG
stages.examples: owner screenshots are read for symbol, timeframe, breakout bar time and the owner's verdict, recorded in examples.json with the screenshot sha256, and re-rendered with the same renderer from Binance USD-M data (frozen 5m series up to 2026-09-23, Binance public klines after); owner charts are OKX, so prices can differ slightly
stages.judge: Zhipu glm-5.3-flash through yoyo.vision_research.zhipu.ZhipuClient.analyze (prompt spike-vision-zhipu-v4-project-rules, right-edge launch semantics) with the owner criteria below and owner reference renders; one ledger row per (image, references, criteria, model, prompt); no automatic retry; failures stay unknown
stages.evaluate: agreement of VLM verdicts with owner labels on examples not used as references (split by event), against a label-shuffle null; only then a larger VLM run on candidates and an exit test with squeeze_breakout_v1.simulate_many (3R/5R, stop below the MAs, 0.2% cost, matched controls), select before 2025-01-01, check after

universe: monthly top-100 alts by previous-month quote volume plus BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT (as v1)
exits: as v1: next-bar open entry, stop min/max six MAs -/+ 0.2 ATR, fixed 3R and 5R, stop first on a shared bar, 192-bar cap; 20 controls per candidate with ATR/price within 0.5-2x
